title: SMS: Regional Director, Nairobi — "Geneva Wants a Call Within the Hour"

bubbles.text: Alberto Matsinhe — Geneva just called me asking why a journalist knows about Buzi before they do. Camille Laurent wants a call within the hour.
What is the activation time, what is the staff count, and is anyone hurt?
Mariam Sesay is on the plane in 45 min and lands Beira around 11:45 with no comms until then. What do you need him to bring?
Copying Mariam Sesay, who is at JKIA and boards at 07:40. Call me or Geneva first, then text him the list. Don't wait on the reporter.

instructorNote: This is a pressure inject that checks whether the CD notifies the CMT chair and the Regional Director within 2 hours of the 06:00 activation. The CD should give the facts as they stand: 61 of 64 accounted for, 3 out of contact since 19:40, movements stopped, the UNDSS alert shared, and warehouse loss estimated at about one-fifth but not counted. Staff names should go only to people who need them. Watch that the EC gets a short brief and a list of what to bring before boarding, and that the CMT chair activates the CMT and logs the time.
